design_rationales.concrete_problem: Bidirectional coherence and autoregressive efficiency are otherwise fixed competing regimes, while strict AR accumulates long-range error.
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: Bidirectional intra-chunk attention widens context while causal inter-chunk generation reuses clean-history KV cache.
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: Uniform fixed chunks are simpler; one full chunk gives maximum context but less streaming and potentially more repeated computation.

design_rationales.concrete_problem: High-noise structure planning and low-noise local refinement need different temporal context ranges.
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: Large early chunks provide global planning, then inserted boundaries create finer later chunks for efficient detail refinement.
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: A fixed schedule avoids buffer/synchronization complexity; nested constraints also restrict the full schedule search space.

design_rationales.concrete_problem: One model must remain valid under causal, non-causal, and hybrid attention masks at inference.
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: Stochastic partitions expose the generator to heterogeneous causal and bidirectional contexts during self-rollout.
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: A curriculum or separate specialized models could be used; the chosen chunk-size sampling range lacks sensitivity analysis.

design_rationales.concrete_problem: Few-step causal generation suffers a train-test exposure mismatch.
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: Self-generated rollout states and distribution matching train a few-step generator under its own inference distribution.
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: Native AR training or teacher forcing are simpler but address exposure differently; most of this pipeline is inherited from prior work.

design_rationales.concrete_problem: Clean past keys and noisy current/future keys have mismatched signal-to-noise ratios within one attention computation.
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: A timestep-conditioned linear map expresses clean cached keys in the current noisy representation space without rewriting the cache.
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: Recomputing cache, separate normalization, or projecting both K and V are alternatives; their accuracy and runtime trade-offs are not compared.

design_rationales.concrete_problem: When a parent chunk is split at the next timestep, a later sub-chunk cannot proceed before prior-subchunk KV cache exists.
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: The runtime buffers the parent result and resumes each child in temporal order after causal dependencies become available.
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: Fixed partitions or recomputation avoid some scheduler state but lose flexibility or add compute; buffering may increase peak memory.

design_rationales.concrete_problem: Small local edits in an autoregressive generator can propagate and alter later global structure.
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: Keeping early planning fixed and changing only late refinement conditioning confines the edit to lower-level details.
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: Inversion or masked editing may allow larger structural changes; late-only editing restricts edit scope.

design_rationales.concrete_problem: Strict left-to-right causal generation cannot independently revise a middle segment without regenerating the suffix.
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: The target chunk attends both preceding and following clean chunks, relaxing temporal order during editing.
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: Regenerating the suffix preserves strict causality but costs more and risks drift; bilateral context needs full-video cache.
